name: RSSHub
description: RSSHub is an open source, easy to use, and extensible RSS feed generator. It's capable of generating RSS feeds from pretty much everything.

variables.name: Cache Type
variables.description: Cache type, memory or redis, empty this value will disable caching, default to memory

variables.name: Cache Expire
variables.description: Route cache expiry time in seconds, default to 5 * 60

variables.name: Redis URL
variables.description: Redis target address (invalid when CACHE_TYPE is set to memory), default to redis://localhost:6379/
